purpose: Evaluate a whole through two representative features.
keywords: N + といい + N + といい
In both color and shape, this bowl is beautiful.
Both the taste and aroma are flawless.
His manner and language alike are rude.
formation: N + といい + N + といい
restrictions: The paired features typically support the same overall judgment.
mistake: Unlike といわず, this emphasizes chosen features rather than every part.
